title: PST-Auto-Agent: A Multi-Agent Ensemble Framework for Paper Source Tracing

contributions.purpose: 多智能体集成解决论文溯源(PST)
contributions.mechanism: 集成 DeepSeek-R1-0528 + GPT-5 + Gemini-2.5-pro;XML 解析 + 反事实/多角色苏格拉底提示工程 + 加权预测/默认打分/一致性惩罚集成
contributions.evaluation: 免调参、免特征工程的强基线
contributions.domain: 学术信息溯源 / 多智能体 LLM
contributions.source_quote: we propose a novel multi-agent ensemble architecture, pst-auto-agent, which integrates multiple state-of-the-art LLMs with advanced prompt engineering and intelligent ensemble strategies

contributions.mechanism: PST-Bench 上以 MAP 评估
contributions.evaluation: 集成 MAP=0.388,+22.0% 相对提升(单模型 DeepSeek 0.246 / GPT-5 0.315 / Gemini 0.318)
contributions.source_quote: achieving a MAP score of 0.388, significantly outperforming strong baseline models

contributions.purpose: 展示与特征工程结合的实用性
contributions.mechanism: 与 KDD Cup 2024 领先方案 English Hercules 结合
contributions.evaluation: 提升 KDD Cup 2024 leaderboard 排名(互补效应)
contributions.source_quote: We illustrate the practical impact of our approach by showing its ability to enhance the performance of a leading method in the KDD Cup 2024 competition.

notes: overclaim 红旗:贡献列表首条'We formally define the PST problem and introduce PST-Bench (Zhang et al., 2024)'—同句将他人已发布的基准 PST-Bench 引用给 Zhang et al. 2024,却表述为'we introduce',把既有数据集列为自身贡献,措辞矛盾/贡献夸大。统计显著性 checklist 诚实答 No(单次测试无误差棒),Broader impacts 答 No。有编号贡献列表。MAP 0.388,ensemble 相对单模型 +22%。
